notes.title: Patch.25.6.00
notes.content: [p]Sry, because happened some network errors today, the net was just restored.[/p][p](Forgive my noob en,the patch recode is a big challage for me)[/p][p][/p][p]the addition and modification:[/p][p]1.Add the KR version (still have A little text bugs).[/p][p]2.Add the fast save point in the chapter.1.[/p][p]3.Modify the auto resolution apply in code and add the part of set resolution.[/p][p]4.Increase the running speed by 10% in chapter.1 and change the animation speed.[/p][p][/p][p]the fixed bugs:[/p][p]1.In the controller logic.When staying the fast healing area,the tip will still exit if close or change bag.[/p][p]2.In the controller logic.When card select targets,maybe the quickly select will get a dead target.[/p][p]3.In the controller logic.When close or change bag,the bag class will not conform to vision.[/p][p]4.In the controller logic.In battle,if u open the stack and do save part,will cant close stack.[/p][p]5.Remove that auto select frist card after controller use one card.[/p][p]6.Fixed skill's energy counter of \[Little Ash knight] will keep until next battle.[/p][p]7.Fixed some shader bug of Chapter.1.[/p][p]8.Fixed \[Booze] have some possibility of use failure.[/p][p]9.Fixed the deep mine's stone gate did not require gem.[/p][p]10.Fixed enter the grim room,have some possibility of healing failure.[/p][p]11.Fixed the CD player can't be correctly open in battle.[/p][p]12.Increase the speed of open bag, change the battle failure's UI postion[/p][p][/p][p][strike](I think the en patch notice have more bugs)[/strike]ːrbrb3ː[/p]
